credits.name: Hotel Credit (FHR / The Hotel Collection)
credits.notes: Prepaid bookings via AmexTravel. THC requires 2-night min; FHR can be 1 night.

credits.name: Lululemon Credit
credits.notes: Terms exclude gift cards but in-store/online physical gift cards typically still trigger credit.

credits.name: Resy Dining Credit
credits.notes: U.S. participating Resy restaurants. Some online restaurant gift-card portals trigger; in-restaurant safest.

credits.name: Saks Fifth Avenue Credit
credits.notes: Discontinued by Amex effective 2026-07-01; H1 2026 (Jan–Jun) was the final $50 window. Gift-card workaround officially closed since 2023.

credits.name: Digital Entertainment Credit
credits.notes: Subscribe to one eligible service (Disney+, Hulu, Peacock, NYT, WSJ, YouTube TV/Premium, Paramount+, ESPN+).

credits.name: Uber Cash
credits.notes: $15/mo + $20 bonus in December (=$35 Dec). Auto-loaded as Uber Cash when Platinum is on Uber account.

credits.name: Uber One Membership
credits.notes: Covers Uber One subscription; charge to Platinum after enrolling.

credits.name: CLEAR Plus
credits.notes: Pay annual CLEAR membership with Platinum once per year.

credits.name: Airline Incidental Fee Credit
credits.notes: Bags / in-flight food / seat selection on ONE selected airline. NOT tickets, NOT gift cards.

credits.name: Equinox Credit
credits.notes: $25/mo for Equinox+ digital, or up to $300 toward club fees. Skip if not a member.

credits.name: Walmart+ Credit
credits.notes: Up to $12.95/mo reimbursement on monthly Walmart+ membership. Must be monthly (not annual).

credits.name: Oura Ring Credit
credits.notes: One-time $200 toward an Oura Ring purchase via Oura.com. Not gift-cardable.

credits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
credits.notes: $120 every 4 years (or $85 PreCheck every 4.5 yrs). Annualized ~$30.

credits.name: Amex Offers (variable)
credits.notes: Targeted offers in the Amex app. Worth bulk-enrolling all available offers each month.

credits.name: Dining Credit (Grubhub/BWW/Five Guys/Cheesecake/Wonder)
credits.notes: $10/mo on listed merchants. Easiest: load $10 to Grubhub balance.

credits.name: Resy Credit
credits.notes: Two use-it-or-lose-it windows: $50 Jan 1–Jun 30 (H1) + $50 Jul 1–Dec 31 (H2) at U.S. participating Resy restaurants. Does NOT roll over between halves. Same gift-card caveats as Platinum Resy. (Corrected 2026-06-28: was modeled as a single annual $100 lump.)

credits.name: Dunkin' Credit
credits.notes: Loading $7+ to your Dunkin' app stored-value triggers credit. Buying a physical gift card does NOT.

credits.name: Uber Cash
credits.notes: $10/mo Uber Cash auto-loaded when Gold is on Uber account.

credits.name: Chase Travel Hotel Credit
credits.notes: Up to $100/anniversary year on hotels booked via Chase Travel. Anniversary-year reset (not calendar) — uses cards.anniversary_month=9. No enrollment. The anchor benefit; offsets the $95 annual fee. (Verified 2026-06-28.)

credits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck / Nexus
credits.notes: Up to $120 every 4 years toward Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or Nexus. annual_value amortized 120/4=$30 to match the Platinum convention. (Verified 2026-06-28.)

credits.name: DoorDash Non-Restaurant Credit
credits.notes: $10/calendar month on one qualifying non-restaurant (grocery/convenience/retail) DoorDash order. Requires DashPass activation. Forfeits if unused; no rollover — the highest-effort, most-notifiable credit. (Verified 2026-06-28.)

credits.name: DoorDash DashPass Membership
credits.notes: Complimentary DashPass (>=12 mo); activate by 2026-12-31. Comp membership, not a $ statement credit — annual_value = ~$96 retail for reference only; the reconciler intentionally skips it (won't match a transaction). Enroll-once. (Verified 2026-06-28.)

credits.name: Apple TV Subscription
credits.notes: Complimentary Apple TV (>=12 mo); enroll by 2026-12-31 (one-time). Comp subscription, not a $ statement credit — annual_value ~= retail for reference only; the reconciler intentionally skips it. (Verified 2026-06-28.)
